chunks: While those you beseech apart from Him cannot help you or even help themselves.
ai.seo_question: Why can't idols or false gods help their worshippers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf is often cited to demonstrate the ontological inferiority of created beings, including angels and prophets, who are merely servants of God and thus lack independent power (istid'af). It reinforces the concept of Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah by showing that while intercessors may be revered, they cannot grant benefit or harm except by God's permission, distinguishing them from the Self-Sufficient Allah. This highlights the practical implication of directing worship solely to God, as all other entities are fundamentally dependent and powerless.
